title: BCP-78 John Wimmer 1st Bowman 2024 Refractor LA Angels (RC) Topps Chrome
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Introducing the BCP-78 John Wimmer 1st Bowman 2024 Refractor LA Angels (RC) Topps Chrome trading card. This sports trading card features the rookie John Bowman from the Los Angeles Angels team in the Major League (MLB). The card is part of the 2024 Bowman set and has a chrome parallel/variety with a card number of 2024. 

It's a perfect addition to any baseball enthusiast's collection. The card is not autographed and is manufactured by Topps. This trading card is a must-have for fans of the Los Angeles Angels and collectors of sports memorabilia.
